user.title: Connect WhatsApp HA
user.description: Connect WhatsApp HA to your WWebJS API server. Sessions will be discovered automatically.

data_description.url: Base URL reachable from Home Assistant, for example http://192.168.1.20:3000.
data_description.api_key: The API_KEY configured on the WWebJS API server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WhatsApp HA
reconfigure.description: Update the server URL or API key. The connection is tested before the entry is saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate WhatsApp HA
reauth_confirm.description: The saved API key was rejected. Enter the current API key for the WWebJS API server.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the WWebJS API server

abort.already_configured: This WWebJS API server is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: The YAML configuration could not be imported because the WWebJS API server could not be reached
abort.invalid_auth: The YAML configuration could not be imported because the API key was rejected
abort.reauth_successful: The WhatsApp HA API key was updated successfully
abort.reconfigure_successful: The WhatsApp HA connection was updated successfully

search_contacts.name: Search contacts
search_contacts.description: Return contacts from a WhatsApp session whose identity fields match a Python regular expression. The WWebJS API connection is selected automatically from the configured WhatsApp HA integration. Every JSON attribute supplied by the contacts API is preserved on each matching contact, including nested ID data, booleans, labels, names, number and future fields.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: The WWebJS session to search, for example default or personal. The integration automatically uses the configured connection that owns this session.

pattern.name: Regular expression
pattern.description: Python regular expression matched against name, pushname, shortName, verifiedName, number, and contact ID fields. Use (?i) for case-insensitive matching. Matching contacts are returned with all API attributes unchanged.

session_start.name: Start WhatsApp session
session_start.description: Start a new WhatsApp Web session on the configured WWebJS API connection. A pairing QR code will appear through the session's Pairing QR code camera entity when available.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: The session name to create or start, for example default or personal.

session_end.name: End WhatsApp session
session_end.description: Terminate and log out a WhatsApp Web session. This removes the stored session login and requires pairing again before it can reconnect.

session_id.name: Session ID
session_id.description: The session to terminate and log out.

no_loaded_connection.message: No loaded WhatsApp HA connection is available.

ambiguous_api_connection.message: More than one WhatsApp HA API connection is loaded, so a new session cannot be assigned automatically.

ambiguous_session_connection.message: Session {session_id} exists on more than one WhatsApp HA connection, so the connection cannot be selected automatically.

session_connection_not_found.message: Session {session_id} was not found on any loaded WhatsApp HA connection.

no_session_available.message: No WhatsApp session is currently available for notify.whatsapp_send_message.

ambiguous_notify_session.message: More than one WhatsApp session is available. notify.whatsapp_send_message will not guess which account should send the message.

session_start_failed.message: The WhatsApp session could not be started: {error}

session_end_failed.message: The WhatsApp session could not be ended: {error}

notify_send_failed.message: The WhatsApp message could not be sent: {error}
